summary: Comprehensive frontend E2E testing of Famly app (Indonesian family manager). 12/12 critical flows pass: login page render, register->dashboard, create family (with invite code + limit bars + tabs), expense add (with Rp formatting), task CRUD (add/toggle/delete via data-testid task-submit-btn/task-toggle-{id}/task-delete-{id}), upgrade modal (Rp 49.000 + close), logout, role-based routing (admin auto-redirect to /admin on login AND on visiting /, non-admin visiting /admin redirected to /), admin dashboard rendering (sidebar 'Family Admin', stats cards Total User/Active Subscribers/MRR/Suspended, subscribers table), admin actions (Upgrade -> Premium Aktif, Downgrade, Suspend, Unsuspend per-user), and Transaksi sidebar tab. UI text Indonesian as expected, terracotta theme present, data-testid coverage strong.
critical_code_review_comments: Task submit button uses data-testid='task-submit-btn' (icon-only +). Consistent with expense form which uses data-testid='add-expense-btn' (text 'Tambah'). Minor naming inconsistency between 'add-expense-btn' and 'task-submit-btn' - consider standardizing to add-<entity>-btn for clarity.

Dashboard.jsx around the task list relies on tasks-list testid but individual task rows don't carry a row-level testid (task-item-{id}) - would aid future tests that need to assert per-row content/state.

Admin subscribers table renders all users without pagination/search - fine for MVP but at >50 users becomes a UX problem; iteration_1 already noted no audit trail for admin actions which is more critical.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend fully verified for all 12 review flows. Notes for future: (1) task add button is icon-only Plus, use data-testid='task-submit-btn' (NOT 'add-task-btn'). (2) Expense add button uses data-testid='add-expense-btn' AND text 'Tambah'. (3) Admin auto-redirects /->/admin in App.js Protected component; non-admins on /admin redirect to /. (4) Upgrade modal: do NOT click upgrade-confirm-btn (real Stripe redirect). (5) Indonesian copy: 'Masuk' (login), 'Daftar' (register), 'Tambah' (add), 'Tugas' (task), 'Pengeluaran' (expense), 'Keluarga' (family), 'Gratis' (free), 'Premium Aktif' (premium active), 'Suspended'. (6) Currency format uses dot as thousand separator (Rp 49.000, Rp 25.000) -- Indonesian locale. (7) During run admin dashboard showed 7 total users with the newly-created UI test user visible at the top of the subscribers list.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs. The only initial test failure (task_crud) was a test-script selector miss (looked for 'add-task-btn' / 'Tambah' text on a + icon button). Re-ran with correct data-testid='task-submit-btn' -> full task add/toggle/delete cycle works perfectly.
